title: An Improved Interpolation Theorem and Disproofs of Two Conjectures on 2-Connected Subgraphs
summary: We prove that any \(2\)-connected graph \(G\) on \(n\) vertices with minimum degree \(δ(G) \ge \frac{n}{4}+2\) contains a \(2\)-connected subgraph of order \(k\) for every integer \(k\) with \(4 \le k \le n\). This improves a previous result of Yin and Wu. In \cite{YinWu-DAM-2026}, Yin and Wu proposed two conjectures. The first states that for any \(2\)-connected graph \(G\) of order \(n\) and size \(m\), there exists a \(2\)-connected subgraph of order \(k\) for each \(k \in \{4, \dots, n\}\) whenever \(m \ge \frac{1}{2} n^{3/2}\).
